units.source_text: 朱雀院五十庆寿，于十二月二十五日举行。

en.t: Suzaku-in's fiftieth birthday celebration was held on the twenty-fifth day of the twelfth month.

units.source_text: 柏木这位名重一时的大臣患了重病，

en.t: Kashiwagi, a minister whose name had lately carried great weight, had fallen gravely ill,

units.source_text: 他的父母亲和许多兄弟，以及这高贵家族中的人，都正在忧伤悲叹。

en.t: and his parents, his many brothers, and all the people of that noble family were sunk in grief and lamentation.

units.source_text: 此时举办贺宴，似乎不能尽兴。

en.t: To hold a celebratory banquet at such a time seemed unlikely to bring anyone real enjoyment.

units.source_text: 然而此事已经一延再延，不能就此搁置，怎么可以再缓呢！

en.t: Yet the matter had already been postponed again and again; it could not simply be set aside, so how could they delay it any longer?

units.source_text: 源氏推想三公主心中不快，甚是同情。

en.t: Genji imagined how unhappy the Third Princess must feel and was deeply sympathetic.

units.source_text: 庆寿之日，照例由五十处寺院诵经礼佛。

en.t: On the day of the birthday rites, as was customary, sutras were recited and Buddhist devotions performed at fifty temples.

units.source_text: 朱雀院所居之寺中，则礼拜摩诃毘庐遮那。

en.t: In the temple where Suzaku-in lived, worship was offered to Mahavairocana.
